name: reactor-mode-2-menu-open
description: #76: menu. From reactor-entrance, press Triangle (4 frames every second) until g_GameState reads menu (5): menu_wait is the first frame it does. Then wait for a picture still for 30 frames (the menu drawn; menu_still), and check it still reads 5 (menu_ok) and that g_PrevGameState reads field (1). match: a rerun from the same snapshot. Keeps "menu-open".
